verses.geez: ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ አይኑ፡ ዝንቱ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ኅዳጋቲሃ፡ ለእምክሙ፡ ዘፈነውኩ፡ ላቲ፤ ወለመኑ፡ እፈዲ፡ ዕዳ፡ ዘሤጥኩክሙ፤ አኮኑ፡ በኃጢአትክሙ፡ ሤጥኩክሙ፡ ወበጌጋይክሙ፡ ፈነውክዋ፡ ለእምክሙ።
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord, Of what kind is your mother's bill of divorcement, by which I put her away? or to which debtor have I sold you? Behold, ye are sold for your sins, and for your iniquities have I put your mother away.

translations.lxx: Thus saith the Lord, Of what kind is your mother's bill of divorcement, by which I put her away? or to which debtor have I sold you? Behold, ye are sold for your sins, and for your iniquities have I put your mother away.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
translations.ron: Aşa zice Domnul: Unde este cartea de despărţire cu care am alungat pe mama voastră? Sau care este datornicul Meu, căruia Eu v-am vândut? Pentru că numai pentru fărădelegile voastre aţi fost vânduţi şi pentru păcatele voastre am alungat pe mama voastră.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ መጻእኩ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ሰብእ፤ ጸዋዕኩ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘተሠጥወኒ።
verses.translation: Why did I come, and there was no man? why did I call, and there was none to hearken? Is not my hand strong to redeem? or can I not deliver? behold, by my rebuke I will dry up the sea, and make rivers a wilderness; and their fish shall be dried up because there is no water, and shall die for thirst.

translations.lxx: Why did I come, and there was no man? why did I call, and there was none to hearken? Is not my hand strong to redeem? or can I not deliver? behold, by my rebuke I will dry up the sea, and make rivers a wilderness; and their fish shall be dried up because there is no water, and shall die for thirst.
translations.kjv: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.
translations.ron: Pentru ce când veneam nu găseam pe nimeni şi când strigam nimeni nu răspundea? Oare mâna Mea este prea scurtă, ca să răscumpere, sau nu am destulă putere, ca să izbăvesc? Prin certarea Mea sec marea şi râurile le prefac în pustiu; peştii din ele mor, că nu mai este apă şi se sfârşesc de sete.

verses.translation: I will clothe the sky with darkness, and will make its covering as sackcloth.

translations.lxx: I will clothe the sky with darkness, and will make its covering as sackcloth.
translations.kjv: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
translations.ron: Eu îmbrac cerul cu zăbranic şi îl acopăr cu un veşmânt de jale.

verses.geez: እግዚአብሔር፡ እግዚእ፡ የሀበኒ፡ ልሳነ፡ ጥበብ፡ ከመ፡ አእምር፡ ቃለ፡ ዘእነብብ።
verses.translation: The Lord even God gives me the tongue of instruction, to know when it is fit to speak a word: he has appointed for me early, he has given me an ear to hear:

translations.lxx: The Lord even God gives me the tongue of instruction, to know when it is fit to speak a word: he has appointed for me early, he has given me an ear to hear:
translations.kjv: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
translations.ron: Domnul Dumnezeu Mi-a dat Mie limbă de ucenic, ca să ştiu să grăiesc celor deznădăjduiţi. În fiecare dimineaţă El deşteaptă, trezeşte urechea Mea, ca să ascult ca un ucenic.

verses.geez: ወተግሣጸ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይከሥተኒ፡ እዝንየ፡ አንሰ፡ ኢይክሕድሂ፡ ወኢይትዋሣእሂ።
verses.translation: and the instruction of the Lord, even the Lord, opens mine ears, and I do not disobey, nor dispute.

translations.lxx: and the instruction of the Lord, even the Lord, opens mine ears, and I do not disobey, nor dispute.
translations.kjv: The Lord GOD hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
translations.ron: Domnul Dumnezeu Mi-a deschis urechea, dar Eu nu M-am împotrivit şi nici nu M-am dat înapoi.

verses.geez: መጠውኩ፡ ዘባንየ፡ ለመቅሠት፡ ወመልታሕትየኒ፡ ለጽፍዐት፤ ወኢሜጥኩ፡ ገጽየ፡ እምኃፍረተ፡ ምራቅ።
verses.translation: I gave my back to scourges, and my cheeks to blows; and I turned not away my face from the shame of spitting:

translations.lxx: I gave my back to scourges, and my cheeks to blows; and I turned not away my face from the shame of spitting:
translations.kjv: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
translations.ron: Spatele l-am dat spre bătăi şi obrajii mei spre pălmuiri, şi fata Mea nu am ferit-o de ruşinea scuipărilor.

verses.geez: ወእግዚአብሔር፡ እግዚእ፡ ረዳእ፡ ኮነኒ፤ በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኢተኀፈርኩ፡ ወረሰይኩ፡ ገጽየ፡ ከመ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ወአእመርኩ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትኀፈር።
verses.translation: but the Lord God became my helper; therefore I was not ashamed, but I set my face as a solid rock; and I know that I shall never be ashamed,

translations.lxx: but the Lord God became my helper; therefore I was not ashamed, but I set my face as a solid rock; and I know that I shall never be ashamed,
translations.kjv: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
translations.ron: Şi Domnul Dumnezeu Mi-a venit în ajutor şi n-am fost făcut de ocară. De aceea am şi întărit faţa Mea ca o cremene, căci ştiam că nu voi fi făcut de ocară.

verses.translation: for he that has justified me draws near; who is he that pleads with me? let him stand up against me at the same time: yea, who is he that pleads with me? let him draw nigh to me.

translations.lxx: for he that has justified me draws near; who is he that pleads with me? let him stand up against me at the same time: yea, who is he that pleads with me? let him draw nigh to me.
translations.kjv: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
translations.ron: Apărătorul Meu este aproape. Cine se judecă cu Mine? Să ne măsurăm împreună! Cine este potrivnicul Meu? Să se apropie!

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይረድአኒ፡ መኑ፡ ያሐሥም፡ ላዕሌየ፤ ናሁ፡ ኵልክሙ፡ ከመ፡ ልብስ፡ ትበልዩ፡ ወከመ፡ ፃፄ፡ ትትበልዑ።
verses.translation: Behold, the Lord, the Lord, will help me; who will hurt me? behold, all ye shall wax old as a garment, and a moth shall devour you.

translations.lxx: Behold, the Lord, the Lord, will help me; who will hurt me? behold, all ye shall wax old as a garment, and a moth shall devour you.
translations.kjv: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
translations.ron: Iată, Domnul Dumnezeu Îmi este întru ajutor; cine Mă va osândi? Iată, ca un veşmânt vechi toţi se vor prăpădi şi molia îi va mânca!

verses.geez: መኑ፡ እምኔክሙ፡ ዘይፈርሆ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ይስማዕ፡ ቃለ፡ ገብሩ።
verses.translation: Who is among you that fears the Lord? let him hearken to the voice of his servant: ye that walk in darkness, and have no light, trust in the name of the Lord, and stay upon God.

translations.lxx: Who is among you that fears the Lord? let him hearken to the voice of his servant: ye that walk in darkness, and have no light, trust in the name of the Lord, and stay upon God.
translations.kjv: Who is among you that feareth the LORD, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD, and stay upon his God.
translations.ron: Cine din voi se teme de Domnul să asculte glasul Slugii Sale! Cel care umblă în întuneric şi fără lumină să nădăjduiască întru numele Domnului şi să se bizuie pe Dumnezeul lui!

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ኵልክሙ፡ ታነድዱ፡ እሳተ፡ ወአዕበይክሙ፡ ነበልባለ፤ ሖሩ፡ እንከ፡ በብርሃነ፡ እሳትክሙ፡ ወነበልባል፡ ዘአንደድክሙ፤ በእንቲአየ፡ ረከብክሙ፡ ዘንተ፡ ኵልክሙ፡ ትሰክቡ፡ በሕማምክሙ።
verses.translation: Behold, ye all kindle a fire, and feed a flame: walk in the light of your fire, and in the flame which ye have kindled. This has happened to you for my sake; ye shall lie down in sorrow.

translations.lxx: Behold, ye all kindle a fire, and feed a flame: walk in the light of your fire, and in the flame which ye have kindled. This has happened to you for my sake; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
translations.kjv: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
translations.ron: Voi toţi, care aprindeţi focul şi pregătiţi săgeţi arzătoare, aruncaţi-vă în focul săgeţilor voastre pe care l-aţi aprins! Din mâna Mea vi se întâmplă una ca aceasta; pe patul durerii veţi fi culcaţi!
